intuition: A per-item max-heap can expose the highest bid, while a current-state map identifies obsolete heap records.

brute_force.approach: Store each item's bids and scan all active bidders for the maximum on every query.

optimal.approach: Keep current bid versions by item and user, and push versioned negative-priority records into item heaps.
optimal.time: add/update/remove O(log n), getHighestBidder O(log n) amortized

edge_cases: Equal bid amounts choose the greatest user ID.
An item with no active bids returns -1.
